method: Direct inspection of generated images plus final checkerboard comparison. Local image QA only, no independent review or application test suite.

A_refined.observation: Top-row addition fixed the four-row failure. Red/green/yellow cups remain mixed naturally; narrow frame and open short side retained. Preferred geometry candidate.

B_refined.observation: Five tiers retained. Neighboring flavor-color blocks give a more organized stocked appearance. Small generation drift remains, including shelf edge angle relative to A.

projection_note: Both pass the diagnostic slope interval [-0.53,-0.47] used in prior pilot QA. This tolerance is a diagnostic, not a claim of the user's exact-match requirement being proven.
dimension_note: Originals are 1202x1308; canonical is 442x481. Top cups extend above the canonical empty fixture. Whole-alpha bbox aspect is not a direct fixture-dimension comparison. No shear/stretch/rotation/independent-axis resize has been applied. Exact world-scale and landmark registration remain unverified.
alpha_note: True alpha-zero exterior; no pixels above alpha8 touch the canvas border. Generated interior alpha is mostly 252-254, preserved unchanged. Checkerboard is in comparison image only.
